name: Onclick to Top
author: Akash Ahmed

sections.description:
Onclick to Top allow users return to the top of any page or post, eliminating the need for tedious scrolling. Customize the button’s appearance to match your website’s design is also applicable.

🔥 Features

🖱️ Smart Scroll Detection – Button automatically appears when users scroll down the page for easy navigation.
📏 Fully Customizable Size – Adjust button dimensions to perfectly match your site’s design.
🎨 Color Customization – Change icon color, background, and progress bar to blend with your brand.
🔄 Dynamic Positioning – Place the button on left or right with pixel-perfect margin control.
🔲 Border Styling – Customize border size, style, and radius for a polished look.
⚡ Smooth Scroll Control – Adjust scroll speed for the perfect user experience.
📱 Device-Specific Visibility – Show/hide on mobile, tablet, or desktop as needed.

🔥 New Features

👆 Admin Panel Button – Quick access to top right from your WordPress dashboard.
🧭 Drag & Drop Positioning – Visually place the button anywhere on screen with intuitive dragging.
🖼️ Custom Icon Upload – Use your own logo or icon instead of the default arrow.

📚 How to use

You can use this plugin with some steps, like:

  • Search and Install the HR Scroll Top Plugin. You will be redirected to the plugin admin page after installing it.

  • You can change everything from here like change Icon, Change Background Color & Icon Color, Change Scroll Speed, Change the icon Round & Corner and can change the icon Position on your website.

*Then you go to your website and you will find an awesome Scroll To Top Icon with all functionality.

IMPROVMENTS

  • Update UI on setting page
sections.faq:
01. Does Onclick to top works with all WordPress themes?

Yes.
